item.title: Champagne in Washington to talk trade, critical minerals with G7 countries
item.description: OTTAWA — Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne is in Washington, D.C., Sunday and Monday for meetings on trade and critical minerals.

item.title: Military will get to Manitoba First Nation dealing with water issues on Monday: chief
item.description: PIMICIKAMAK — The chief of a Manitoba First Nation in the throes of severe water issues, including flooding and backed-up sewage, says seven members of the Canadian Armed Forces are to arrive in his northern community on Monday.

item.title: Why using hazard lights while driving in bad weather is a mistake
item.description: While it might seem safer to turn on your hazard lights during snow, the OPP warns that doing so can confuse other drivers and even disable important signals like turn indicators

item.title: Canada not considering a ban on X over deepfake controversy, AI minister says
item.description: OTTAWA — Artificial Intelligence Minister Evan Solomon says Canada isn’t considering a ban of the social media platform X, though his office says discussions about X's deepfake controversy are underway.

item.title: VIDEO: Unlike other provinces, Ontario won’t sell off stockpile of U.S. booze
item.description: 'We've sent a very clear signal': Finance Minister says the Ford government won't follow the lead of other jurisdictions when it comes to millions of dollars in American alcohol pulled off store shelves

item.title: Former NHL rookie of the year looks back as Blueshirts celebrate century on ice
item.description: 'I played with guys like Brad Park and Walter Tkachuk, great players. I still love the Rangers,' says area resident Steve Vickers, whose name still dots franchise's record books

item.title: THOMPSON, William “Bill” Norman
item.description: With broken hearts the family of William Norman Thompson “Bill” announce his passing on January 7th, 2026 at the age of 71.

item.title: HITCHEN, Donna Darlene
item.description: After almost 65 years the final promise has been kept. We are sad to announce the passing of Donna Hitchen on January 9, 2026. She has now reunited with her parents Babe (Marion) and Glen Snider and her brother Rick.

item.title: Cyclist dead after alleged hit-and-run crash in southwestern Ontario, police say
item.description: GLEN MORRIS — Police in southwest Ontario say they've arrested a driver who they allege left the scene following a fatal collision involving a cyclist.

item.title: Ontario woman facing charges following assault on airplane
item.description: SIOUX LOOKOUT — A woman has been charged after police say an assault occurred on an airplane in northwest Ontario.
